card.title: BCBA Quality Assurance Director
card.description:
**BCBA Quality Assurance Supervisor**
=====================================

**Little Champs ABA**

Little Champs ABA is seeking a highly organized, motivated, and compassionate **BCBA Quality Assurance Supervisor** to join our growing team. This full-time leadership position will work directly under the Clinical Director to ensure clinical excellence, staff compliance, training quality, and operational support across multiple states.

The ideal candidate is a licensed BCBA with strong leadership, organizational, and multitasking skills who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about supporting both clients and clinical staff.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The BCBA Quality Assurance Supervisor will oversee quality assurance processes for clinical services, monitor BCBA and RBT compliance and hours, coordinate trainings and orientations, and provide ongoing support to clinical teams. This role plays a critical part in maintaining high standards of care and ensuring compliance with company policies, insurance requirements, and state regulations.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Clinical Quality Assurance**

* Conduct quality assurance reviews for BCBA and RBT documentation
* Monitor clinical compliance and ensure adherence to ABA best practices
* Review treatment plans, supervision logs, session notes, and authorizations
* Assist in maintaining company-wide clinical standards and procedures
* Support implementation of quality improvement initiatives

### **Staff Oversight & Support**

* Track and manage BCBA and RBT supervision hours and requirements
* Monitor staff credentialing and compliance deadlines
* Provide ongoing support and guidance to BCBAs and RBTs
* Collaborate with clinical leadership to address staff performance concerns
* Help ensure clinical teams are supported across multiple states

### **Training & Orientation**

* Oversee all staff trainings and new hire orientations
* Coordinate onboarding processes for clinical staff
* Assist with development and implementation of training materials
* Ensure staff remain current with required certifications and trainings
* Support continued professional development initiatives

### **Administrative & Leadership Duties**

* Work closely with the Clinical Director on company-wide initiatives
* Assist with audits, compliance reviews, and operational processes
* Maintain organized records and tracking systems
* Communicate effectively with multidisciplinary teams
* Participate in leadership meetings and support company growth initiatives

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Active and unrestricted **BCBA certification required**
* Master’s degree in ABA, Psychology, Education, or related field
* Minimum of 2 years of BCBA experience preferred
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively
* Experience working across multiple states preferred
* Excellent communication and leadership skills
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive full-time salary
* Health insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* 401(k) with company match
* Supportive leadership team
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement

**About Little Champs ABA**
---------------------------

Little Champs ABA is dedicated to providing high-quality ABA services to children and families, including underserved and rural communities. We are committed to clinical excellence, compassionate care, and supporting our team members in making a meaningful impact.

**Join our team and help us continue making a difference in the lives of children and families.**

card.description:

This job is part of the Contract Quality Management job function. They are responsible for managing the delivery of contractual services to ensure requirements are fulfilled.

* Execute both company and confidential client compliance programs and participate in continuous improvement objectives.
* Create initiatives and communicate issues across the functional areas. Report compliance status to key stakeholders and sr. management regularly.
* Manage the execution and evaluate the success of the quality-of-service initiatives for non-regulated services.

* Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention is preferred.

* Leadership skills to motivate the team to achieve broad operational targets with impacts on own job discipline, multiple job disciplines, and department.

* Extensive organizational skills and an advanced inquisitive mindset.

***Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.***

card.title: Senior Consultant, Quality (VP-Level)
card.description:
This individual will serve as an integral consultant with exposure to multiple facets of business operations. The **Senior Consultant, Quality** will be responsible for helping to set strategic direction and operational oversight of the quality function addressing all aspects of GXP compliance.This consultant ensures all internal processes and external partnerships strictly adhere to global regulatory standards, including FDA, EMA, and ICH guidelines.

**This role can be up to 10 hours per week to start.**

 

Elicio (ELTX) is a growing organization based out of the Seaport area of Boston, Massachusetts with additional staff functioning in a virtual based environment from the Greater Boston area and throughout the United States.

 

**Key Responsibilities Include**

 

* **Strategic Leadership:**Develop and execute a comprehensive quality and compliance vision that aligns with the company’s clinical and commercial objectives.
* **Quality Management System (QMS):**Design, implement, and maintain a robust QMS—including document control, change management, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) systems—that scales with the company's growth.
* **GxP Compliance Oversight:**Ensure full compliance across all GxP areas, including Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Clinical Practices (GCP), and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP).
* **Regulatory Interaction:**Serve as the primary liaison for regulatory health authorities during inspections and audits; lead the strategy for inspection readiness.
* **External Partner Management:**Oversee quality at external vendors, including contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs) and clinical research organizations (CROs), ensuring consistent quality standards and negotiating quality agreements.
* **Product Disposition:**Hold ultimate accountability for the review and release (disposition) of raw materials, intermediates, and final drug products for both clinical trials and commercial sale.
* **Culture & Talent:**Build and mentor a high-performing quality organization while championing a "Quality First" culture across all departments.

 

**Education & Professional Experience**

 

* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or technical discipline (e.g., Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy) is required. An advanced degree (MS, PhD, or MBA) is strongly preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive leadership in quality within the biotech or pharmaceutical industry.
* Deep knowledge of global regulatory frameworks (FDA 21 CFR Part 11, 210/211, and ISO standards) and experience in biologics or small molecule manufacturing, and parenteral products. Experience with peptide-based vaccines is a plus.
* Proven track record of managing outsourced operations successfully leading organizations through regulatory inspections and commercial product launches.
* Must thrive in a fast-paced innovative start-up environment.
* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills for interacting with executive teams and regulatory agencies.
* Strong risk management and analytical problem-solving abilities.
* Strategic thinking with a "hands-on" approach to building quality organizations and quality systems.

 

**Working Model**

**Weekly hours:** This role can be up to 10 hours per week to start. It may increase or decrease over time.

**Working Conditions:** Busy home office/office/laboratory environment with frequent deadlines and interruptions.

**Travel:** Travel may be required to the Company’s headquarters a few times per year, if necessary.

**Physical Requirements:** Subject to periods of sitting or standing, vision is required to monitor data.

**Work Location:** Hybrid preference but will consider remote

**About Elicio Therapeutics**

Elicio Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: ELTX) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company advancing a pipeline of novel lymph node-targeted immunotherapies for the treatment of some of the most aggressive cancers. By combining expertise in immunology and immunotherapy, Elicio is harnessing the natural power of the immune system with the AMP technology, which allows for therapeutic payloads to be delivered directly to the lymph nodes, with the goal of enhancing the immune system’s cancer-fighting capabilities. By targeting cancer immunotherapies to the core of the immune response, AMP aims to optimize the lymph nodes’ natural ability to educate, activate and amplify cancer-specific T cells, which are essential for recognizing and eliminating tumor cells. Engineered to synchronize immunity in these highly potent sites, AMP is built to enhance the magnitude, potency, quality and durability of the immune response to drive antitumor activity. The Company’s R&D pipeline includes off-the-shelf therapeutic cancer vaccines ELI-002, (targeting mKRAS-driven cancers) as well as ELI-007 and ELI-008 (targeting BRAF-driven cancers and p53 hotspot mutations, respectively). For more information, please visit www.elicio.com.

**About the Amphiphile Platform**

 

Elicio Therapeutics’ proprietary Amphiphile (“AMP”) platform delivers investigational immunotherapeutics directly to the “brain center” of the immune system – the lymph nodes. Elicio believes this site-specific delivery of disease-specific antigens, adjuvants and other immunomodulators may efficiently educate, activate, and amplify critical immune cells, potentially resulting in induction and persistence of potent adaptive immunity required to treat many diseases. In preclinical models, Elicio has observed lymph node-specific engagement driving therapeutic immune responses of increased magnitude, function and durability. Elicio believes our AMP lymph node-targeted approach will produce superior clinical benefits compared to immunotherapies that do not engage the lymph nodes based upon preclinical studies. Elicio’s AMP platform, originally developed at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology has broad potential in the cancer space to advance a number of development initiatives through internal activities, in-licensing arrangements or development collaborations and partnerships. The AMP platform has been shown to deliver immunotherapeutics directly to the lymph nodes by latching on to the protein albumin, found in the bloodstream, as it travels to lymphatic tissue. In preclinical models, Elicio has observed lymph node-specific engagement driving immune responses of increased magnitude, function and durability.

card.title: Director, Process Engineering - Head of Internal Operations
card.description:
We’re here for one reason and one reason only – to cure cancer. Every moment is dedicated to developing treatments and every action moves us one step closer to our goal. We’ve made incredible scientific breakthroughs and our pioneering personalized CAR T-cell therapies have changed the paradigm. But we're not finished yet.

 

Join Kite, as we make even bigger advances in cancer therapies, and help shape where our business and medical science goes next.

 

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfill their aspirations. Join Kite and help create more tomorrows.

**Job Description**
-------------------

 

We will consider candidates in Foster City, El Segundo, Oceanside and Thousand Oaks, CA

 

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
========================

**Strategic and Functional Leadership**
---------------------------------------

* Set the Internal Operations strategy, priorities, governance, and resource plan in alignment with Network MSAT, Process Development and Manufacturing-site needs, and enterprise objective.

* Lead project leaders and technical SMEs by establishing clear accountabilities, decision rights, and escalation pathways.

* Build a capable, inclusive, and accountable team; develop successors and strengthen project leadership, process stewardship, and investigation capabilities.

* Serve as the primary connection between Network MSAT and manufacturing sites, translating site priorities and technical risks into network actions.

* Define and monitor practical measures for portfolio delivery, process-document maturity, investigation effectiveness, risk reduction, and realized business value.

* Advise the Head of Network MSAT and senior stakeholders on operational risk, organizational capability, deploy resources and investments, as required, to deliver near- and long-term objectives, in a scalable manner.

* Provide leadership during high-impact manufacturing events, risks, regulatory challenges, and technical investigations; with clear executive communication.

**Global Project and Portfolio Leadership**
-------------------------------------------

* Accountable for leading a focused portfolio of highly-complex, cross-site MSAT projects with clear outcomes, milestones, resources, risks, and governance.

* Partner with cGML and Process Design to reflect lessons learned and improvements made to our commercial operations, which has strengthened process robustness, operational readiness, and cost effectiveness.

* Integrate project execution with validation, regulatory, supply, and site implementation plans to support predictable delivery.

**Process Stewardship and Standardization**
-------------------------------------------

* Own the governance and lifecycle of standardized global process documentation, including enhanced Process Description Reports (ePDRs).

* Lead global MSAT impact assessments for change controls and lifecycle changes to maintain cross-site consistency and reduce process drift.

* Expand process stewardship to pFMEAs, control strategy linkages, reusable technical knowledge, and effective handoffs into routine operations.

**Global Investigations and Technical Problem Solving**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Lead complex cross-site investigations involving process performance, critical quality attributes, comparability, assay variability, and recurring manufacturing issues.

* Establish a consistent global investigation framework, including trigger and escalation criteria, a practical playbook, analytical tools, and lessons learned.

* Ensure investigation conclusions are scientifically sound and translated into sustainable process improvements or lifecycle actions.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
========================

* Bachelor's degree in chemical engineering, biochemical engineering, biotechnology, biochemistry, biology, chemistry, or a related scientific/engineering discipline with 12+ years of relevant experience; OR a Master's degree with 10+ years of relevant experience; OR a PhD with 8+ years of relevant experience.

* Significant people-leadership experience, including leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment.

* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional programs across multiple sites or business units, including strategy, governance, prioritization, resource planning, risk management, and delivery through others.

* Demonstrated leadership of global or cross-site investigations involving process performance trends, critical quality attributes, comparability, assay or method variability, and product-impact assessment.

* Demonstrated experience supporting cGMP manufacturing, process lifecycle management, technical investigations, change impact assessment, CAPA, and inspection readiness.

* Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, apply systems thinking, influence senior stakeholders without direct authority, and translate technical risks into clear business decisions.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with senior leaders and represent the organization in high-stakes technical and operational forums.

* Strong relationship-building and influencing skills, with the ability to align senior stakeholders and lead effectively without direct authority.

* Clear, concise, and audience-appropriate communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical topics into business decisions.

* High learning agility, sound judgment, and comfort operating through ambiguity, changing priorities, and incomplete information.

* Demonstrated emotional intelligence, active listening, constructive challenge, and conflict-resolution skills.

* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance urgent operational needs and longer-term capability development.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
============================

* Direct experience across MSAT, Manufacturing, Quality, Lifecycle Management, Technology Transfer, and/or Process Development.

* Experience in cell therapy, gene therapy, viral vector, biologics, aseptic processing, or other complex biotechnology manufacturing platforms.

* Experience leading technology transfers, new product introductions, validation/PPQ, comparability, continued process verification, and post-approval lifecycle changes.

* Working knowledge of Lean, Operational Excellence, DMAIC, statistical process control, Quality by Design, FMEA, and structured root cause analysis.

* Experience using data, analytics, automation, or digital tools to improve portfolio decisions, technical investigations, process monitoring, and knowledge management.

* Proven success developing technical experts, establishing new organizational capabilities, and leading transformation while sustaining near-term business delivery.

card.description:
Harvest Solar, an equal opportunity employer, is a Michigan-based company that provides cost-effective renewable energy for agriculture, commercial, and utility customers yielding more energy independence by utilizing solar energy. We believe in energy independence and a sustainable future for our children and grandchildren. Our purpose is to empower people to create and use renewable energy by providing them with the best‐in‐class service, products, and experience. 
 
**Position Title and Purpose of Position** 
The Director of Quality will develop, coordinate, and implement quality and commissioning policies and procedures to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant operations throughout the organization. The Director of Quality is responsible for site specific quality and commissioning compliance within both Harvest’s and the customer’s requirements. The Director of Quality will work closely with onsite Harvest Solar project management, direct-labor staff, customer’s representatives, and subcontractors to ensure all work is completed to established requirements.

**Salary** 
The salary range for this role is $110,000.00 to $130,000.00 USD, salary commensurate with education and experience. An Annual Bonus Target representing 10% of your annual base salary/annual wages is paid based on meeting both organizational and individual targets. 
 
**Major Responsibilities of Position**

* Ensure a “Safe Culture” through employee engagement, training, coaching, and compliance
* Responsible for planning, developing, implementing, maintaining, and improving quality and commissioning policies and procedures in compliance with Harvest requirements along with customer, Utility, and AHJ requirements
* Responsible for planning, developing, implementing, and providing quality and commissioning training for relevant employees
* Identifies opportunities to improve existing policies and procedures
* Maintain quality and commissioning records using Procore and other customer required systems
* Prepare written reports of findings and recommendations for corrective or preventive measures where indicated; follow up to ensure measures have been implemented
* Work with project management teams and field workers to implement solutions to quality issues on project sites
* Provide technical support to Preconstruction department for quoting and proposals
* Represent company in meetings with governing bodies (AHJ, utilities), subcontractors, and customer on issues regarding quality and commissioning
* Responsible for managing direct reports
* Other duties as assigned

The successful candidate will have: (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Other Attributes)

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
* Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, employees, and the public
* Ability to prioritize tasks especially when handling an accident or incident
* Ability to manage daily priorities and ensure task accomplishment
* Ability to communicate effectively, both oral and written
* Thorough knowledge of health and safety laws and guidelines
* Extensive attention to detail to distinguish safety hazards
* Good understanding of data analysis and risk assessment
* Good organizational, leadership and motivational skills
* Maintain regular and acceptable attendance
* Willing to work hours necessary to support the accomplishment of organizational goals

**Educational and Certification Background**

* High school diploma or GED – Required.
* Bachelor’s degree in safety management and five years’ experience; or ten years’ experience coordinating safety & environmental programs; experience in construction environment preferred.
* Valid State Driver’s License – Required
* OSHA 30 - Preferred
* MIOSHA Level I or Level II Certification, or OHSA 500 - Preferred

**Work Environment**

* Commercial Construction Setting 20% of the time: Job Site terrain and outdoor work with exposure to weather fluctuations in addition to construction site hazards. Installers travel to work sites and therefore, travel is required 100% of the time. Harvest values our employees work life balance and whenever possible, overnight travel is Monday through Friday. Hotel and transportations costs are covered. Additionally, a food per diem is paid for overnight stays.
* Travel Required 20% of the time: Position supports job site activities therefore daily and overnight travel is required. Harvest values our employees work life balance and whenever possible, overnight travel is Monday through Friday. Hotel and transportations costs are covered. Additionally, per diem is paid for overnight stays.

**The First of the Month after the Date of Hire**:

* Health Insurance. The premiums are a shared expense with 80% covered by Harvest Solar and 20% covered by the associate via a weekly payroll deduction. Premiums are based on level of coverage, (i.e., Associate only, Associate & Spouse, Associate & Child(ren), Family).

Harvest Solar will make the following weekly deposit into your HSA account based on the coverage options: Associate: $10.64; Associate & Spouse: $27.25; Associate & Child(ren): $21.65; Family: $37.55
* Option 2: Priority Health, Traditional HMO 1000 Plan

card.title: Director of Quality Improvement & Corporate Compliance
card.description:
Description:

**Help strengthen the quality, integrity, and impact of behavioral healthcare.**

Monadnock Family Services (MFS) is seeking an experienced, thoughtful, and collaborative **Director of Quality Improvement and Corporate Compliance** to provide organization-wide leadership for quality improvement, regulatory compliance, and organizational accountability.

This is an important opportunity for someone who believes quality improvement should be more than audits and reports. At MFS, this position will help turn data, feedback, and identified concerns into meaningful improvements that strengthen services, protect consumer rights, support employees, and promote organizational effectiveness.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, the Director will work closely with executive leadership, program directors, clinical leaders, and the Board of Directors to ensure that quality and compliance are integrated into the way the organization operates.

**What You'll Do**

**Lead Quality Improvement**

* Direct the agency's quality improvement program and establish meaningful measures of organizational and program performance.
* Analyze performance data, audit findings, consumer feedback, and service outcomes to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
* Partner with program leaders to develop, implement, and evaluate quality improvement initiatives and corrective action plans.
* Report quality findings, organizational trends, and improvement progress to executive leadership and the Board.

**Oversee Corporate Compliance**

* Develop, maintain, and monitor the agency's Corporate Compliance Plan.
* Monitor compliance with applicable federal and New Hampshire regulations, licensing standards, payer requirements, and contractual obligations.
* Coordinate the review of potential compliance concerns and support appropriate investigations and corrective actions.
* Communicate regulatory changes and compliance expectations to agency leadership.

**Strengthen Consumer Rights and Risk Management**

* Oversee the agency's complaint and grievance processes and serve as an escalation resource for complex or sensitive concerns.
* Lead the critical incident review process and monitor trends, recommendations, and follow-through.
* Work with clinical and program leadership to identify risks and implement strategies that improve safety and service quality.

**Support Documentation, Privacy, and Regulatory Readiness**

* Oversee clinical recordkeeping standards and quality monitoring activities.
* Support agency compliance with HIPAA and applicable confidentiality requirements.
* Coordinate preparation for licensing reviews, audits, accreditation activities, and external monitoring.
* Support staff education related to documentation, privacy, compliance, incident reporting, and consumer rights.

**Lead and Develop the Quality Improvement Team**

* Supervise and develop Quality Improvement staff, including the Complaint Manager and Medical Records Specialist.
* Establish clear expectations, priorities, and performance standards.
* Promote collaboration, accountability, and continuous professional development.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate brings a combination of analytical ability, regulatory knowledge, leadership experience, and sound professional judgment. They are comfortable examining complex issues, asking difficult questions, and working collaboratively to develop practical solutions.

Requirements:

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Master's degree in a clinical, behavioral health, healthcare administration, public health, business administration, or related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* Demonstrated experience in quality improvement, corporate compliance, healthcare administration, behavioral health operations, or a related field.
* Experience interpreting and applying regulatory, licensing, contractual, or payer requirements.
* Experience developing or monitoring quality improvement initiatives, performance measures, audits, or corrective action plans.
* Experience supervising employees or leading cross-functional initiatives.
* Strong analytical, organizational, written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a Community Mental Health Center or other regulated healthcare setting.
* Familiarity with New Hampshire behavioral health regulations and licensing requirements.
* Experience with accreditation, external audits, regulatory reviews, or compliance program administration.
* Training or experience in quality improvement methodologies such as PDSA, Lean, Six Sigma, or root cause analysis.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means building a quality and compliance program that is active, useful, and respected throughout the organization. The Director will help ensure that:

* Quality measures inform decisions and lead to measurable improvements.
* Compliance concerns are identified, appropriately addressed, and monitored through resolution.
* Complaints and critical incidents result in meaningful review and follow-through.
* Leadership and the Board receive clear, timely information about organizational performance and risk.
* Program leaders and employees understand their shared responsibility for quality and compliance.

**Why Join Monadnock Family Services?**

MFS is committed to providing timely access to safe, high-quality, results-driven, and sustainable mental healthcare for our communities rooted in best practices, respect, and compassion.

This position offers the opportunity to contribute at an organizational level, work directly with senior leadership, and help shape the systems and practices that support quality behavioral healthcare throughout the communities we serve.

If you are a strategic thinker who values accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement, we invite you to consider joining our team.

**Apply today to be part of the work that strengthens behavioral healthcare in our communities.**

Monadnock Family Services is an equal opportunity employer.

card.title: Regional Director (EMS & NEMT Operations)
card.description:
**Regional Director – EMS & NEMT Operations**

**Department:** Operations 
**Reports To:** Director of EMS Operations and Director of NEMT Operations 
**Territory:** Assigned Geographic Region – Multiple Branch Locations 
**Position Type:** Full-Time, Exempt (subject to applicable law) 
**Travel:** Regular regional travel required

**Position Summary**

The Regional Director – EMS & NEMT Operations is responsible for the overall operational performance, financial results, growth, staffing, leadership development, and service quality of Hospital to Home's EMS and Non-Emergency Medical Transportation divisions within their assigned region.

Reporting directly to both the Director of EMS Operations and Director of NEMT Operations, this position provides regional leadership and accountability for all transportation services within its territory, including ambulatory, wheelchair, and van stretcher transportation, as well as Basic Life Support (BLS), Advanced Life Support (ALS), ALS II, Critical Care Transport (CCT), and other specialized medical transportation services.

The Regional Director provides direct oversight and leadership to the General Managers within their assigned region, ensuring that each branch operates efficiently, meets established financial and operational goals, maintains appropriate staffing and fleet readiness, and delivers consistent, high-quality service.

This position serves as the primary operational link between corporate leadership and branch-level management, ensuring that company objectives, policies, financial expectations, and operational initiatives are effectively implemented throughout the region.

The Regional Director is expected to maintain a comprehensive understanding of both EMS and NEMT operations, recognizing the unique requirements of each service line while promoting consistency, collaboration, resource efficiency, and accountability across the region.

This is a hands-on leadership position requiring the ability to manage multiple geographically dispersed operations, develop effective management teams, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive sustainable growth across both divisions.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**1. Regional Operational Oversight**

* Direct and oversee all EMS and NEMT operations within the assigned region.
* Provide direct leadership, supervision, and accountability to Branch General Managers.
* Establish clear operational expectations and performance standards for each General Manager.
* Ensure consistent implementation of company policies, procedures, and operational initiatives across all assigned branches.
* Monitor daily transportation volume, staffing levels, fleet availability, service performance, and overall branch operations.
* Ensure each branch meets established operational, financial, productivity, and customer service objectives.
* Conduct regular branch visits, management meetings, and operational performance reviews.
* Identify operational deficiencies and develop and implement corrective action plans.
* Ensure appropriate operational coverage and readiness across both EMS and NEMT service lines.
* Coordinate resources between branches when necessary to accommodate transportation demand and operational challenges.
* Maintain consistent communication with both Directors regarding regional performance, operational concerns, staffing needs, and opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure that regional operations remain aligned with the overall strategic direction and expectations of Hospital to Home.

**2. Financial Accountability & Profitability**

* Take ownership of regional financial performance across both EMS and NEMT operations.
* Hold General Managers accountable for meeting established branch budgets and financial objectives.
* Monitor labor-to-revenue ratios, operating gross profit, overtime, fleet expenses, and other controllable operating costs.
* Review branch-level and service-line profitability on a regular basis.
* Identify financial trends, budget variances, and underperforming branches.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve profitability and operational efficiency.
* Ensure appropriate staffing and resource allocation to maximize productivity without compromising patient care or service quality.
* Work with the Directors of EMS and NEMT and Finance to develop and manage annual operating budgets.
* Monitor revenue production, transportation volume, labor utilization, and cost per transport.
* Ensure General Managers understand their financial responsibilities and can effectively manage the financial performance of their respective branches.

**3. Growth & Business Development Support**

* Drive transportation volume and revenue growth throughout the assigned region.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing EMS and NEMT services.
* Partner with Business Development and corporate leadership to support new contracts, customer relationships, and business opportunities.
* Ensure branches have the staffing, equipment, vehicles, and operational capacity necessary to support growth.
* Assist with the development and implementation of new service lines and operational initiatives.
* Support the opening, development, and integration of new branch locations and acquired operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve market presence and expand relationships with hospitals, health systems, skilled nursing facilities, transportation brokers, and other customers.
* Ensure growth initiatives are operationally sustainable and financially responsible.
* Work with General Managers to establish and execute branch-level growth strategies.

**4. Leadership & General Manager Development**

* Provide direct leadership, coaching, and accountability to all General Managers within the assigned region.
* Establish measurable performance expectations and regularly evaluate General Manager effectiveness.
* Develop management teams capable of independently operating successful and financially responsible branches.
* Hold General Managers accountable for financial performance, staffing, employee retention, service quality, compliance, and operational execution.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings and performance reviews with General Managers.
* Identify leadership development needs and provide coaching, mentorship, and additional training where necessary.
* Partner with Human Resources on recruiting, employee retention, succession planning, and management development.
* Address management performance deficiencies promptly and implement appropriate improvement plans.
* Ensure General Managers maintain appropriate oversight of their supervisors and field personnel.
* Promote a culture of accountability, professionalism, communication, teamwork, and employee engagement.
* Identify and develop potential future leaders within the region.
* Recognize strong management performance while addressing deficiencies that negatively impact branch operations.

**5. Staffing, Fleet & Resource Management**

* Monitor regional staffing levels, employee availability, overtime, turnover, and workforce productivity.
* Ensure branches maintain appropriate staffing for their respective EMS and NEMT service requirements.
* Work with General Managers, Scheduling, and Dispatch leadership to address staffing shortages and improve workforce utilization.
* Ensure EMS branches maintain adequate clinical staffing to support required levels of service, including EMTs, Advanced EMTs, Paramedics, and other necessary personnel.
* Ensure NEMT branches maintain appropriate staffing for ambulatory, wheelchair, and stretcher transportation services.
* Monitor fleet availability, vehicle utilization, maintenance schedules, and equipment readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve vehicle utilization and reduce unnecessary downtime.
* Work collaboratively with Fleet Management, Logistics, Scheduling, and Dispatch to ensure regional resources are deployed efficiently.
* Ensure vehicles and equipment are appropriate for the services being provided and meet applicable operational requirements.

**6. Service Quality & Customer Relationships**

* Maintain high standards of customer service, transportation reliability, and patient experience throughout the region.
* Monitor on-time performance, missed transports, cancellations, customer complaints, and service reliability.
* Ensure service failures are investigated and appropriate corrective actions are implemented.
* Support and maintain relationships with hospitals, health systems, skilled nursing facilities, transportation brokers, and other key customers.
* Partner with Business Development and corporate leadership to address customer concerns and support important customer relationships.
* Ensure General Managers maintain appropriate communication with customers and address service issues promptly.
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation coordination, hospital throughput, and overall customer satisfaction.
* Promote consistent service standards across all branches and service lines.

**7. Regulatory Compliance, Safety & Quality Assurance**

* Ensure regional operations comply with applicable federal, Virginia, Medicaid, EMS, NEMT, broker, and transportation requirements.
* Ensure General Managers maintain appropriate oversight of employee credentials, certifications, required training, and regulatory documentation.
* Work collaboratively with Compliance, Safety, Clinical Leadership, and the Medical Director to maintain operational readiness.
* Ensure EMS operations follow approved clinical protocols, applicable regulations, and established medical direction.
* Maintain appropriate separation between operational management authority and clinical decisions reserved for the Medical Director and authorized clinical personnel.
* Ensure NEMT operations comply with applicable transportation, driver qualification, vehicle, and service requirements.
* Monitor operational and patient safety incidents and ensure timely investigation, documentation, and corrective action.
* Support quality assurance initiatives and the implementation of corrective measures.
* Ensure branches maintain appropriate vehicle inspections, equipment readiness, and safety standards.
* Promote a regional culture of safety, regulatory compliance, and operational accountability.

**8. Corporate Communication & Strategic Execution**

* Serve as the primary operational representative for the assigned region.
* Maintain regular communication with both the Director of EMS Operations and Director of NEMT Operations.
* Provide accurate and timely updates regarding regional financial performance, operational challenges, staffing, customer concerns, and growth opportunities.
* Ensure corporate directives, policy changes, and operational initiatives are communicated and implemented effectively at the branch level.
* Participate in leadership meetings, budget reviews, strategic planning sessions, and operational performance meetings.
* Identify recurring challenges that may require corporate resources, policy changes, or additional support.
* Provide recommendations to improve operational consistency, profitability, and organizational effectiveness.
* Ensure General Managers remain informed of company expectations, organizational changes, and departmental initiatives.
* Promote collaboration between EMS and NEMT operations, identifying opportunities to share resources, improve efficiency, and eliminate unnecessary operational duplication.

**Key Performance Indicators**

The Regional Director will be evaluated on the overall performance of their assigned region across both EMS and NEMT operations.

The five primary performance categories include:

**KPI**

**Measurement**

Financial Performance

Actual versus approved budget, operating gross profit, labor-to-revenue performance, and branch profitability

Revenue Growth

Monthly revenue growth by branch and service line

Operational Productivity

Completed transports per vehicle, fleet utilization, employee productivity, and operational efficiency

Service Performance

On-time performance, completed transports, customer satisfaction, and service reliability

Leadership & Compliance

General Manager performance, staffing, overtime, retention, credentialing, and regulatory compliance

Performance will be evaluated at both the regional and individual branch levels, with separate reporting for EMS and NEMT service lines to ensure appropriate visibility into the performance of each division.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Minimum 5 years of transportation, EMS, healthcare, logistics, or related operations management experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple locations and geographically dispersed operational teams.
* Experience supervising managers and holding leadership teams accountable for performance.
* Strong financial management skills, including budget oversight, labor management, and profitability improvement.
* Proven ability to improve operational efficiency and drive sustainable business growth.
* Strong understanding of workforce management, fleet utilization, scheduling, and transportation operations.
* Excellent communication, leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple departments and service lines.
* Ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned region.

**Preferred**

* Experience in both EMS and Non-Emergency Medical Transportation operations.
* Current or previous EMT, Advanced EMT, or Paramedic certification.
* Experience managing BLS, ALS, Critical Care, wheelchair, and stretcher transportation services.
* Familiarity with Virginia Office of EMS requirements and applicable NEMT regulations.
* Experience managing large operational teams and multiple branch locations.
* Experience with financial reporting, operational analytics, and performance management systems.
* Experience with acquisitions, integrations, and organizational expansion.

**Authority & Accountability**

The Regional Director – EMS & NEMT Operations will have direct operational oversight of all assigned regional branches and their respective General Managers.

The position operates under the direction and authority of both the Director of EMS Operations and Director of NEMT Operations, with responsibilities spanning both divisions.

The Regional Director is accountable for:

* Overall operational performance of the assigned region.
* Financial performance, profitability, and budget adherence across both EMS and NEMT operations.
* Performance, development, and effectiveness of regional General Managers.
* Branch-level staffing, workforce productivity, and operational readiness.
* Fleet deployment, availability, and utilization.
* Transportation volume, revenue growth, and operational efficiency.
* Service reliability, patient experience, and customer satisfaction.
* Compliance with applicable operational, regulatory, and safety requirements.
* Successful implementation of corporate initiatives and operational directives.
* Identifying and addressing underperforming branches and management teams.
* Developing a strong, sustainable regional leadership structure.

The Regional Director is expected to exercise sound operational judgment and independently address routine regional challenges while appropriately escalating significant financial, personnel, regulatory, clinical, or operational concerns to the appropriate Director.

Clinical decisions and medical oversight remain under the authority of the Medical Director and designated Clinical Leadership.

**Reporting Structure**

**Director of EMS Operations** 
**Director of NEMT Operations** 
 
**Regional Director – EMS & NEMT Operations** 
 
**Branch General Managers** 
 
**Branch Supervisors and Support Personnel** 
 
**EMS and NEMT Field Personnel**

The Regional Director maintains a dual reporting relationship with the Director of EMS Operations and Director of NEMT Operations with the Director of EMS being their primary reporting manager. Both Directors provide departmental direction, establish expectations, and collaborate in evaluating regional performance.

**Overall Performance Expectations**

The Regional Director – EMS & NEMT Operations is expected to operate their assigned region with the accountability of a business leader, balancing financial performance, operational efficiency, employee development, patient safety, regulatory compliance, customer satisfaction, and sustainable growth.

This position requires a proactive, engaged, and results-oriented leader who can effectively manage General Managers, identify operational deficiencies, develop solutions, and ensure consistent execution of company objectives across multiple branches.

The successful Regional Director will understand that the performance of their region is ultimately a reflection of the effectiveness of its leadership team. They are expected to build capable General Managers, establish clear expectations, hold leadership accountable, and create an environment where each branch can operate successfully with appropriate oversight and support.

The position requires strong collaboration with both the Director of EMS Operations and Director of NEMT Operations, ensuring that the needs and objectives of both divisions are represented and effectively executed.

**Hospital to Home LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This job description describes the general responsibilities of the position and may be modified based on organizational needs.**

The Director will plan, organize, and direct custodial, maintenance, repair, grounds, construction-support, clerical, courier, and related building-services functions. The position combines department-level planning and administration with direct operational supervision, a visible presence in buildings, and active resolution of urgent or complex facility concerns.

The Director supervises the Head Maintenance Worker, construction technicians, building custodians and cleaners, Senior Clerk, couriers, and other assigned Operations and Maintenance personnel.

Direct facilities operations across assigned buildings and sites, establishing consistent service standards, work practices, communication procedures, and accountability.

Supervise personnel and subordinate supervisors; coordinate assignments, schedules, coverage, training, and performance management.

Maintain regular communication with building leaders and inspect facilities firsthand to identify concerns and ensure timely follow-through.

Develop and monitor preventive and predictive maintenance programs for buildings, grounds, systems, vehicles, tools, and equipment.

Coordinate seasonal operations, including heating and cooling transitions, grounds care, snow and ice response, summer maintenance, and support for programs and special events.

Oversee maintenance and repair work performed by employees and contractors, assigning work requiring specialized credentials to appropriately qualified personnel.

Develop short and long range facility maintenance, renewal, and capital recommendations based on safety, program needs, compliance, building conditions, and cost.

card.description:

The Senior Director, Back Operations - Collections is the senior operational leader responsible for domestic hospital and professional collections performance across assigned client portfolios. This role directly leads the domestic collections organization and is accountable for cash acceleration, accounts receivable resolution, aging and inventory reduction, productivity, quality, workforce effectiveness, and achievement of client and operational commitments.

The Senior Director works closely with offshore/global delivery leadership to coordinate collections activities across domestic and global operations, including alignment of work allocation, performance expectations, quality standards, escalation pathways, and reporting.

In addition to direct responsibility for domestic collections, this position provides strategic and operational oversight across the broader back-end revenue cycle, including billing, global collections, denial management, and cash posting. These functions do not report directly to this position. The Senior Director is responsible for ensuring strong cross-functional coordination, identifying dependencies and barriers, facilitating resolution of issues impacting collections performance, and promoting accountability for overall back-end revenue cycle outcomes.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely \* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Domestic Collections Leadership and Performance
 + Provide direct leadership and accountability for domestic collections operations across hospital and professional accounts receivable portfolios
 + Lead a large, distributed organization through directors, managers, supervisors, and frontline collections teams
 + Own domestic collections performance related to cash, days in A/R, aging, inventory reduction, productivity, quality, cost to collect, service levels, and client commitments
 + Establish priorities for collections activities based on payer, aging, balance, account complexity, recovery opportunity, and client requirements
 + Ensure appropriate allocation of staffing and resources to maximize cash recovery and reduce unresolved A/R
 + Maintain disciplined management of aged, high-dollar, complex, and escalated inventories, including underpayments, stalled claims, administrative denials, payer escalations, and accounts requiring cross-functional intervention
 + Hold operational leaders accountable for established performance expectations and lead corrective action and performance recovery when results fall below targeted levels

 + Partner closely with offshore/global collections leadership to align domestic and global collections activities
 + Establish consistent expectations for work allocation, work queues, productivity, quality, documentation, escalation, and performance reporting
 + Align domestic and global work based on account complexity, payer requirements, system access, client commitments, resource capabilities, and automation opportunities
 + Identify and resolve gaps in ownership, handoffs, and accountability that may impede collections performance
 + Maintain effective operating rhythms with global leadership to ensure visibility into performance, capacity, risks, and emerging client needs
* Back Operations Oversight and Integration
 + Provide strategic and operational oversight across billing, global collections, denial management, and cash posting, while maintaining direct leadership accountability for domestic collections
 + Partner with functional leaders to monitor performance, identify risks and dependencies, and address issues that may affect cash flow, aging, collections, or client commitments
 + Facilitate cross-functional resolution of issues involving billing delays, claim defects, denials, payment posting, payer behavior, system access, or workflow breakdowns
 + Establish clear mechanisms for escalating significant performance or operational barriers and monitoring remediation through resolution
 + Promote effective integration across back-end revenue cycle functions and appropriate accountability for end-to-end outcomes
 + Identify recurring operational issues and partner with appropriate revenue cycle leaders to address upstream and downstream root causes

 + Translate operational data into clear actions, priorities, and performance improvement plans
* Operational Excellence, Technology and Continuous Improvement
 + Identify opportunities to standardize and improve collections workflows, work queues, payer strategies, account segmentation, documentation practices, escalation processes, and operating procedures
 + Partner with Product, Technology, Analytics, and Automation teams to identify and prioritize opportunities to improve collections efficiency and effectiveness
 + Sponsor workflow redesign and automation initiatives that reduce manual activity, improve work prioritization, accelerate account resolution, and strengthen quality

**Overview:**

The Operations Director oversees day-to-day operations across multiple departments, manages resources and people, and helps implement workflows to ensure Ambient Inks is running smoothly and in line with our strategic goals. **Our Company:**

What started as a 2-human screen printing shop in a garage in 2009, has quickly evolved into an all encompassing artist merch design/production/management/fulfillment company based in Eau Claire, WI. We work with any array of artists from those that play house shows to artists touring the globe, along with various other clients that share our values. We’re committed to doing business in a way that puts people and planet first, a mindset that rethinks the impact merch can have on our world.

For more info about what we’re all about, check out our website.

December 2026

The expected salary range for this position is $60k–$65k annually.

* Understands Ambient Inks on a deep level, including its philosophy, staff/positions, roster, products, services, and provides ideas to continually improve our operations

* Maintains personal accountability, is timely, efficient, organized, precise, proactive, thorough, and collaborative in how they work, and models these attributes to staff

* Oversees day-to-day operations within Production, Logistics, and Fulfillment, ensuring our clients are satisfied and our products are meeting Ambient Inks’ standards

* Helps to establish benchmarks and goals for the various departments, and supports in the achievement of those goals

* Thinks innovatively on how to improve systems, processes, and policies company-wide in an effort to achieve our goals

* Works with Account Managers to address procedural issues and collaborate to solve problems

* Collaborates with leadership on how to improve efficiencies and create better systems/workflows within their department. Works with leadership to establish goals and holds them accountable for ensuring new systems are implemented and executed, and that goals are being met
